_comment_injection: The environmentally perturbed source. All 14 waveform parameters; anything not listed in 'infer' stays pinned here for the template too.
_comment_disk: Accretion disk the injection is evolved through. Sigma0 is given in g/cm^2 and converted to geometric units from m1 at load time. The template never sees these.
_comment_infer: The fit vector. 'a' is deliberately absent: it is held at its injected 0.0.
_comment_waveform: T in years, or null to run to plunge times T_safety.
_comment_bounds: Clips the +-sigma_range Fisher box to what the waveform can take. p0's floor is the separatrix plus the pad; the phases are periodic and need none.
_comment_de: Passed straight to scipy.optimize.differential_evolution, bar report_every.
_comment_lm: House CV controls, identical to every script under src/{EMRI,IMRI}.
_comment_output: Relative paths resolve next to this config file.
